subject: Mercantile: Elevated latency & error spike - RCA kickoff and follow-through
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-10-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mercantile: Elevated latency & error spike - RCA kickoff

Team —

Quick heads-up: Mercantile reported a sustained latency increase and elevated 5xx rate on their inference routes between 08:30–09:10 PDT this morning. Customer on-call (Olivia) opened a bridge; they saw ~3x p50 and a spike to ~6% 5xx for ~40m. I joined the bridge and escalated to engineering.

Can we treat this as a priority RCA? Ask: 1) confirm root cause hypothesis, 2) proposed short-term mitigation, 3) list of owners + SLAs for action items, and 4) a customer-facing timeline.

I've attached the logs the support team uploaded (prelim). Please take initial ownership of the technical RCA, Markus, and coordinate the account ask (credits, timeline) with Kimberly.

Attaching: mercantile_prelim_rca.pdf (logs + customer telemetry).

- Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0182

---
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-29T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mercantile: Elevated latency & error spike - RCA kickoff

Naomi / team —

Initial findings from the morning bridge and trace sampling:
- Symptom: throughput plateau + rising tail latency coincident with a batch-config change we rolled at 08:00 (reduce-batch-window v2).
- Root cause hypothesis: an interaction between reduced batching window and recently enabled KV-prefetching combined with an aggressive cache clean job. The smaller batch window increased RPCs per second; combined with synchronized KV cache evictions (approx every 30m) this caused transient thundering and increased token generation retries that bubbled up as 5xx from the downstream runtime.
- Evidence: trace ids and span durations match the cache eviction windows (see attached snippet). Error rate maps to span retries where backend reported 'kv-miss-and-retry'.

Short-term mitigation (owner: ben_carter):
1) Roll back the 08:00 reduce-batch-window v2 and revert to prior batching policy (ETA 30m).
2) Stagger cache clean jobs across nodes to avoid synchronized evictions (ETA 2–4 hours for rollout).
3) Throttle KV-prefetch to per-shard concurrency limit while we instrument better telemetry (ETA 24h).

Longer-term (post-RCA):
- Adjust batching heuristics to include dynamic circuit-breaker for KV miss rate.
- Add golden prompt regression tests to catch throughput regressions at rollout.

I'll start the rollback immediately and update once the rollback stabilizes. Attaching prelim log extracts and span mappings.

- Markus
Markus Klein
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
markus_klein@redwoodinference.com

2) Mercantile's procurement team will want clarity on SLA repercussions and any credits given. Please include an initial proposal; we need a written timeline to share internally.

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@mercantile.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-10-31T10:00:00-07:00
Subject: Mercantile: RCA deliverable + action tracker (initial)

Hi Olivia / team —

Attached is our initial RCA package (mercantile_prelim_rca.pdf) plus an action tracker (mercantile_action_tracker.xlsx). Exec summary:
- Impact window: 2027-10-29T08:28:00-2027-10-29T09:08:00 PDT (approx 40 minutes).
- Customer-visible effect: ~3x p50 increase and peak 6.2% 5xx (mainly from token-gen retries); some client retries were observed, causing partial duplicate requests for a small subset of traffic. Mercantile's logs corroborate a fall in successful completions during window.
- Root cause: release (reduce-batch-window v2) + synchronized KV cache eviction + recent KV-prefetch concurrency increase.

Action items (summary):
A1) Rollback reduce-batch-window v2 — owner: Ben Carter — status: completed 2027-10-29T09:02 PDT.
A2) Stagger cache-cleans and add jitter — owner: Ben Carter — ETA: 2027-10-29T13:00 PDT.
A3) Implement per-shard KV-prefetch throttle and telemetry — owner: Markus Klein — ETA: 2027-10-30 end of day.
A4) Update runbook and add gating tests for batching changes — owner: Markus Klein / Eng — ETA: 2027-11-04.
A5) Customer remediation package (credits + report) — owner: Kimberly Park — proposal below.

Kimberly — suggested customer remediation: 25% service credit for the impacted hour (applied as usage credit), a short-term SLA addendum to ensure prioritized routing for Mercantile for next 30 days, and a follow-up readout in two weeks with verification metrics. Please advise/approve.

Next steps: Kimberly will coordinate the credit proposal; Markus and Ben will confirm telemetry once throttles and staggering are live. I'll schedule an exec readout w/ Mercantile next week.

Best —
Naomi

Subject: Re: Mercantile: RCA deliverable + action tracker (initial)

Thanks Naomi — and thanks for the rapid remediation work (Ben / Markus).

On credits & next steps: Mercantile, we propose a 25% credit for billable usage during the impacted hour applied as a one-time invoice credit, plus a 2-week elevated-support window (priority routing + twice-weekly health checks). If you need a different remediation, let us know — we can adapt.

Internal notes: please record the credit as a customer_concession (Deal: DEAL-MERC-2026-09), route the DocuSign for the SLA addendum to legal, and have billing prepare the credit memo. Ben — confirm the staggered cache-job rollout completed and paste verification metrics when done. Markus — paste the KV-prefetch telemetry once throttles are live.

— Kimberly Park
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@mercantile.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T17:04:00-07:00
Subject: Mercantile: Final RCA v1 + closure notes

Olivia / team —

Attached: mercantile_final_rca_v1.pdf (full write-up) and the action tracker marked complete for items A1 and A2. Summary of closure items and verification:
- Rollback: completed at 2027-10-29T09:02 PDT — p50 latency returned to expected distribution within ~6 minutes.
- Cache staggering: rollout completed 2027-10-29T12:40 PDT across all serving nodes; observed elimination of synchronized eviction peaks.
- KV-prefetch throttle: initial throttle deployed 2027-10-30T18:30 PDT; telemetry shows KV-miss retries reduced by ~78% in the sampled window.
- Tests & runbook: gating tests created for batching changes; will be merged into mainline by 2027-11-04.

Remediation package: Kimberly will apply the 25% credit for the impacted hour; billing ticket created (BILL-6241). We will provide a 2-week elevated support window starting 2027-11-01.

Follow-up: scheduling a 30-day verification check (2027-12-01) to confirm no regressions in throughput or error rate and to review the new telemetry dashboards.

If Mercantile signs the SLA addendum, we'll treat this as closed and move to normal cadence.

Thanks for your partnership and for sharing logs — helped accelerate correlation.

- Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: mercantile_final_rca_v1.pdf, mercantile_action_tracker.xlsx
